title: player-session
objective: A real play session on the shipped example: transitions announced, memory recalled, nothing the player should not see, and the session journal correlates it all.

checks.goal: the story loads and the first real transition fires from play alone

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 2 }); const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings; if (!s.enabled || !s.profileId) throw new Error(`extraction not configured after import: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`); return s;

send_generate.text: I shoulder past the morning drinkers and get close to the job board.
I read the brightest posting aloud: the Sun Ruins job. "Arin, look at this one."
I trace the seal on the Sun Ruins posting with a finger, still standing at the board.

checks.goal: the checkpoint change is announced in the chat itself
in player mode the drawer shows no author-only internals
player surfaces speak the story's language, not the implementation's
one composed narrative 'where am I' surface exists

steps.eval: const status = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getNarrativeStatus(); if (!status?.text) throw new Error('empty narrative status'); const ids = status.sections.map((s) => s.id); if (!ids.includes('now') || !ids.includes('status')) throw new Error('narrative missing sections: ' + ids.join(',')); return { ids, text: status.text.slice(0, 200) };

checks.goal: a stalled pipeline is visibly distinct from a slow one, and the signal clears when the re-check lands

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); const state = rt.getEngineState(); rt.recordReconciliation({ checkpointId: snap.activeCheckpointId, boundary: state.boundary, targetedKeys: ['stall-probe'] }); return rt.getSnapshot().pipeline;

await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.runExtractionNow(undefined, 'reconcile:stall-probe'); const pipeline = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().pipeline; if (pipeline.state === 'stalled-rechecking') throw new Error('stall signal did not clear after the re-check landed'); return pipeline;
if (document.querySelector('#so-stall-signal')) throw new Error('stall signal still on screen: ' + document.querySelector('#so-stall-signal').textContent); return true;

checks.goal: the session produced memory and injected it into the next generation
the session journal correlates extraction, transition, payload and flag on one timeline

steps.eval: const kinds = new Set(globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSessionJournal().map((e) => e.kind)); const missing = ['extraction', 'transition', 'payload', 'flag'].filter((k) => !kinds.has(k)); if (missing.length) throw new Error(`journal missing kinds: ${missing.join(', ')} (have ${[...kinds].join(', ')})`); return [...kinds];

checks.prompt: During the session, did you always know where the story was and what it wanted from you?
checks.anchors: 1 = lost most of the time · 3 = had to open the drawer to be sure · 5 = always obvious from play

checks.prompt: Did anything you saw spoil what was coming, or reveal what a character was supposed to be hiding?
checks.anchors: 1 = major spoilers · 3 = one small leak · 5 = nothing leaked

checks.prompt: Did the on-screen wording sound like the game, or like the machine running it?
When the story did not move on a turn, could you tell whether it was stuck, thinking, or waiting for you?
checks.anchors: 1 = indistinguishable · 3 = guessed right eventually · 5 = always clear

checks.prompt: Pacing: did the story push when it should have pushed and breathe when it should have breathed?
checks.anchors: 1 = fought me constantly · 3 = acceptable · 5 = felt directed
